title: Walsh noise operator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\rho\in\mathbb R$. The noise operator on real-valued functions on $\{\pm1\}^n$ is the linear operator that multiplies each Walsh monomial indexed by a subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ by $\rho^{|S|}$.
